aarakocran.name: Aarakocran
aarakocran.facts: Dexterity +2, Constitution -1, Charisma -1. Wing flying, eagle eyes. About 5 ft 5 in tall, 200 pounds. Lives up to 45 years. Knows bird speak, hunting.
aarakocran.unlike: Of the races: alone with eagle eyes.
aarakocran.help: Aarakocran are bipedal birdmen, with hands incorporated into their wings. Aarakocran are a little taller than humans, but much lighter due to their bone structure. They are adept flyers with superior vision.

centaur.name: Centaur
centaur.facts: Strength +1, Intelligence +1, Charisma -1, Wisdom -1. Infravision, hardiness, buck. About 5 ft 6 in tall, 1350 pounds. Lives up to 78 years. Knows elvish, foraging.
centaur.unlike: Of the races: alone with hardiness, alone with buck.
centaur.help: Centaurs are large creatures with the body of a horse and the upper torso, head, and arms of a human. Their class choices are limited, but they excel at forestry, and make excellent rangers and druids.

drow.name: Drow
drow.facts: Intelligence +1, Dexterity +3, Constitution -4, Charisma -3. Infravision, sees in the dark, taint of evil, light sensitivity. Resists magic. About 5 ft 5 in tall, 120 pounds. Lives up to 430 years. Knows drowish, darkness globe, faerie fire, undercommon, elvish.
drow.unlike: Of the races: alone with light sensitivity.
drow.help: Drow are the dark cousins to elves. Their existence living underground had radiated their bodies with dark magic and give them advantages in the cold, dark world. However, they hurt plenty when exposed to light. They have the ability to see in the dark, and can prove to be fiercesome fighters. All Drow start off with the ability to cast darkness globe and faerie fire.

dwarf.name: Dwarf
dwarf.facts: Constitution +1, Charisma -1. Infravision, stonecunning. Resists poison. About 4 ft 8 in tall, 200 pounds. Lives up to 290 years. Knows dwarven, mining.
dwarf.unlike: Of the races: alone with stonecunning.
dwarf.help: Dwarves are shorter than humans, but much stockier, and enjoy sporting beards (including the women). They receive one bonus Constitution point, but lose one Charisma point. They also have Infravision, or the ability to see other creatures in the dark. Dwarves are natural Miners, though their class choices will be limited.

elf.name: Elf
elf.facts: Dexterity +1, Constitution -1. Infravision, keen vision. Resists magic. About 5 ft 5 in tall, 120 pounds. Lives up to 430 years. Knows elvish, foraging.
elf.unlike: Of the races: alone with keen vision.
elf.help: Elves are slightly shorter and more slender than humans, but are quick and agile. They receive one bonus Dexterity point, but lose one Constitution point. Elves have Infravision, are skilled at Foraging. Though their class choices are more limited than humans, they have the broadest choices of all demi-humans.

faerie.name: Faerie
faerie.facts: Constitution -1, Dexterity +5. Wing flying. Resists poison, magic. About 1 ft 9 in tall, 12 pounds. Lives up to 430 years. Knows fey, foraging.
faerie.help: Faeries are slightly smaller and lighter than Pixies (another Fairy-kin), but are nevertheless a little less frail than them, even if not quite as nimble. They have glittering butterfly wings on their backs of various amazing colors and shades, the biggest difference between the two races. Their skin likewise has various hues to it, predominantly greens and blues but some other shades are not unknown. They are even more reclusive in spite of their flamboyant nature, but enjoy playing pranks on each other as well as any wanderer happening near their villages.

giant.name: Giant
giant.facts: No stat changes. About 8 ft tall, 400 pounds. Lives up to 290 years. Knows gigantic, boulder throwing.
giant.help: Giants are massive humanoids whose enormous size grants them incredible strength but makes them less agile and intelligent than smaller races. Giants possess natural gigantic abilities and can learn to throw boulders with devastating effect. They are long-lived, with thunderous footsteps that announce their arrival, and massive fists that serve as formidable weapons.

githyanki.name: Githyanki
githyanki.facts: Dexterity +1, Wisdom +1. Sees in the dark. Resists mind attacks. About 5 ft 10 in tall, 135 pounds. Lives up to 260 years. Knows hide, astral step.
githyanki.help: Githyanki are planar travelers from an ancient race whom have taken residence in the Astral Plane. They are tall and gaunt, but also quite powerful. They use their knowledge of the planes to take brief jaunts around obstacles, appearing to teleport into well protected areas.

gnoll.name: Gnoll
gnoll.facts: Intelligence -3, Wisdom -2, Strength +2. Infravision, devour corpse. Resists disease, cold, poison. About 6 ft 4 in tall, 220 pounds. Lives up to 64 years. Knows orcish.
gnoll.unlike: Of the races: alone with devour corpse.
gnoll.help: Gnolls are vicious anthropomorphic hyena-men. They stand 6 feet to 7 and a half feet tall, are lean and violent. Gnolls enjoy displays of cruelty and mercilessness, often pulling limbs from their living prey. They hunt creatures of all sorts, but particularly enjoy hunting intelligent species.

gnome.name: Gnome
gnome.facts: Intelligence +1, Wisdom -1. Infravision, burrowspeak. Resists mind attacks. About 3 ft 7 in tall, 85 pounds. Lives up to 260 years. Knows gnomish, digging, burrow hide.
gnome.unlike: Of the races: alone with burrowspeak.
gnome.help: Gnomes are curious and quick-witted folk, resembling small dwarves. They receive one bonus Intelligence point, but lose one Wisdom point due to their carelessness. They also have Infravision, are skilled at Gem Digging, though their class choices will be limited.

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.facts: Dexterity +2, Strength -1, Charisma -1, Wisdom -1, Intelligence +1. Infravision, carnivorous. About 4 ft tall, 95 pounds. Lives up to 63 years. Knows goblinese, orcish, mining, excavation.
goblin.help: Goblins are small twisted creatures, quick on their feet, and natural tinkerers with all manner of wicked traps and devices Their class choices are limited, but they excel at thieving, and make great miners and delvers. As a carnivore, their hunger is only satiated by the consumption of meat.

halfelf.name: Half Elf
halfelf.facts: No stat changes. Infravision. Resists magic. About 5 ft 10 in tall, 135 pounds. Lives up to 137 years. Knows elvish, fishing, cultural adaptation.
halfelf.help: Half Elves are a mixture of humans and elves, possessing human drive and elven grace. They have Infravision, are skilled Fishermen, and have almost as many class choices as normal Humans.

halfling.name: Halfling
halfling.facts: Dexterity +1, Strength -1. Infravision. Resists paralysis. About 3 ft 7 in tall, 105 pounds. Lives up to 120 years. Knows elvish, cooking, sling, fast slinging.
halfling.help: Halflings are a very short fur-footed folk. They receive one bonus Dexterity point, but lose one point of Strength. They have Infravision, make excellent Cooks, though their class choices will be limited.

halfogre.name: Half Ogre
halfogre.facts: Strength +3, Intelligence -1, Charisma -1, Wisdom -1. About 8 ft 5 in tall, 350 pounds. Lives up to 78 years. Knows gigantic, butchering.

human.name: Human
human.facts: No stat changes. Diligent studying. About 6 ft 2 in tall, 175 pounds. Lives up to 78 years. Knows chopping.
human.unlike: Of the races: alone with diligent studying.
human.help: Just like you and me! Humans are versatile and successful adventurers. They receive 2 bonus training sessions at first level, make powerful lumberjacks. Humans also have the broadest class choices.

lich.name: Lich
lich.facts: Constitution -4, Charisma +6. Infravision. About 5 ft 10 in tall, 150 pounds.
lich.unlike: Of the races: the most Charisma.
lich.help: Lichs are the most feared of the skeletal undead. Although they were a normal race before they died, the decay and corruption makes their former race hard to determine. Lichs lose some constitution for being dead, but gain charisma for their formidable presence. In fact, they walk around with a weak aura of fear at all times. Like other skeletal undead, they take half-damage from piercing or slashing weapons, are never hungry or thirsty, have infravision, stink of grime and decay, take damage from positive healing spells, are healed by negative energy spells, and are immune to poison, mind, gas, paralysis, disease, and negative energy attacks. The most common way to become a lich is to study Necromancy and die.

lizardman.name: Lizard Man
lizardman.facts: Intelligence -1, Charisma -1, Strength +1, Constitution +1. Long breath, swim. Resists lightning. About 6 ft 1 in tall, 225 pounds. Lives up to 78 years. Knows draconic, hunting, tail swipe.
lizardman.unlike: Of the races: alone with long breath.
lizardman.help: These large, bipedal humanoids stand about a head taller than humans. They have a thick three to six foot tail which they use for improved swimming and to protect themselves. Lizard men prefer temperate to tropical environments and can hold their breath underwater for extended periods.

mindflayer.name: Mindflayer
mindflayer.facts: Strength -4, Intelligence +4, Constitution -2, Charisma +2. Sees in the dark, mind suck, detect sentience, combat precognition. Resists magic, mind attacks. About 5 ft 10 in tall, 135 pounds. Lives up to 430 years. Knows mind fog, charm, undercommon.
mindflayer.unlike: Of the races: the most Intelligence, alone with mind suck, alone with detect sentience, alone with combat precognition.
mindflayer.help: Mindflayers, or Illithid, are alien humanoids with a smooth, leathery face with four tentacles surrounding and protecting their mouths. They are taller than humans, but lighter and more frail due to millennia of reliance upon mind-controlled slave labor to do their manual work.

naga.name: Naga
naga.facts: Dexterity +5. Sees in the dark, stigma, auto crawl. Resists poison. About 5 ft 5 in tall, 120 pounds. Lives up to 42 years. Knows draconic, snake speak.
naga.unlike: Of the races: alone with stigma, alone with auto crawl.
naga.help: A sharp-featured humanoid head crowns the powerful, sinuous body of this snake-like monstrosity. Two slender arms extend from the body of the Naga just below the head.

ogre.name: Ogre
ogre.facts: Charisma -4, Dexterity -5, Intelligence -5, Strength +9. Bad reputation. Resists poison. About 6 ft 8 in tall, 335 pounds. Lives up to 148 years. Knows gigantic, orcish, butchering.
ogre.unlike: Of the races: the most Strength, the least Dexterity, the least Intelligence, alone with bad reputation.
ogre.help: Ogres are the less enlightened kin to the giants, possessing great strength and ferociousness at the expense of their intellect and dexterity . As they are naturals at ripping things apart, they make excellent butchers. Their class choices are limited, but any kind of Fighter or Barbarian would suit an ogre very well.

orc.name: Orc
orc.facts: Strength +2, Intelligence -1, Wisdom -1, Charisma -1. Infravision, taint of evil, carnivorous. Resists poison. About 5 ft 6 in tall, 200 pounds. Lives up to 220 years. Knows orcish, undercommon, butchering, vicious blow.
orc.help: Orcs are powerful, brutish porcine humanoids that take great joy in the agony of others. Their society is dictated by the strongest, most-vicious alphas of the tribe, who often band together to create great war-parties to destroy other species` civilizations. As a carnivore, their hunger is only satiated by the consumption of meat.

tabaxi.name: Tabaxi
tabaxi.facts: Dexterity +3, Strength +3, Intelligence -4, Wisdom -2. Infravision, hide, sneak, big cat speak, climb. About 6 ft 1 in tall, 160 pounds. Lives up to 22 years.
tabaxi.unlike: Of the races: the shortest lived, alone with hide, alone with sneak, alone with big cat speak, alone with climb.
tabaxi.help: Half human, half cat, and all claws. The Tabaxi are a honorable warrior race, using their skills to ambush prey from within the shadows and atop trees - though their skills can be bought for a price. Usually solitary hunters, the Tabaxi will follow a leader and form a pack if they deem one to be strong enough

beastkin.name: Beastkin
beastkin.facts: Constitution +2, Dexterity +1, Charisma -1, Intelligence -2. Infravision. Resists cold. About 6 ft 2 in tall, 175 pounds. Lives up to 78 years. Knows hunting, butchering, shape shift, fey.
beastkin.help: All manner of animal-human hybrids, in virtually every ratio. One might even say that certain tribal animists fall under this category, socially and culturally modeling themselves after animals. If it's furry, or has animal ears and a tail, pick this one.

duergar.name: Duergar
duergar.facts: Charisma -4, Constitution +1. Sees in the dark. Resists fire, mind attacks, poison. About 4 ft 8 in tall, 200 pounds. Lives up to 290 years. Knows dwarven, mining, undercommon, invisibility, grow.
duergar.help: Duergar are shorter than humans, but much stockier, and sport long black beards and bald heads. They receive one bonus Constitution point, but lose four Charisma points. They also have Darkvision, or the ability to see other creatures in the dark, and have a talent for Invisibility and Growth. Duergar, like their cousins the Dwarfs, are natural Miners, though their class choices will be even more limited.

ghast.name: Ghast
ghast.facts: No stat changes. Sees in the dark, cause stink. About 5 ft 10 in tall, 150 pounds.
ghast.help: Ghasts are vile twisted undead that have maintained some intelligence from their former life. Their flesh has turned a putrid green, and their eyes burn with vile corruption. Their claws have a strong paralytic effect.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.facts: No stat changes. Sees in the dark, immunities, fear. Resists undead. About 5 ft 10 in tall, 150 pounds.
ghost.unlike: Of the races: alone with immunities, alone with fear.
ghost.help: Ghosts are incorporeal spirits that have unresolved conflicts in the land of the living.

ghoul.name: Ghoul
ghoul.facts: No stat changes. Sees in the dark, cause stink. About 5 ft 10 in tall, 150 pounds.
ghoul.help: Ghouls are vile twisted undead that maintain little intelligence from their former life. Their flesh has turned a putrid green, and their eyes burn with vile corruption. Their claws have a weak paralytic attack.

merfolk.name: Merfolk
merfolk.facts: Dexterity +2, Wisdom -2. Infravision, swim, autoswim. About 8 ft tall, 205 pounds. Lives up to 215 years. Knows aquan, fishing, land legs.
merfolk.unlike: Of the races: alone with autoswim.
merfolk.help: Merfolk are half-fish, half-humanoid dwellers of the sea. They can breathe air and water, enabling trade with surface dwellers. Merfolk are the dominant underwater race.

mummy.name: Mummy
mummy.facts: No stat changes. Sees in the dark, mummy rot. About 5 ft 10 in tall, 150 pounds.
mummy.unlike: Of the races: alone with mummy rot.
mummy.help: Mummies are the preserved corpses of guardians, animated to protect their ward in death. This may be a location, item or individual.

mustie.name: Mustie
mustie.facts: Charisma -2, Wisdom +1, Constitution +2. Sees in the dark, swim. About 4 ft tall, 72 pounds. Lives up to 72 years. Knows burrow, foraging, searching.
mustie.help: Musties, also known as badgerfolk, are small, furry humanoids that resemble badgers. They’re quiet creatures, often lost in thought, and are typically guided by their own internal moral compass.

pixie.name: Pixie
pixie.facts: Dexterity +7, Strength -6, Constitution -7, Charisma +2. Wing flying. Resists poison, magic. About 2 ft 2 in tall, 32 pounds. Lives up to 430 years. Knows fey, foraging, improved invisibility.
pixie.unlike: Of the races: the least Strength, the most Dexterity, the least Constitution.
pixie.help: Pixies are playful fairy-kin, standing roughly two feet tall. These pranksters rarely venture into society, but sometimes enjoy pranking villagers near their woodland habitats. Pixies have transparent butterfly wings and the innate ability to remain invisible as long as they wish. Pixies are vegetarians and eating meat can make them violently ill.

spectre.name: Spectre
spectre.facts: No stat changes. Sees in the dark. Resists undead. About 5 ft 10 in tall, 150 pounds.
spectre.help: Spectres are viscious undead spirits who have returned from beyond the grave to enact violence upon the living. Spectres are often indiscriminant in whom they hurt, unleashing their anger upon any victim in their path.

svirfneblin.name: Svirfneblin
svirfneblin.facts: Strength +2, Constitution -2, Intelligence +1, Wisdom -1. Sees in the dark, untraceable. Resists mind attacks. About 3 ft 7 in tall, 85 pounds. Lives up to 260 years. Knows gnomish, digging, undercommon, blur.
svirfneblin.unlike: Of the races: alone with untraceable.
svirfneblin.help: Svirfneblin, or Deep Gnomes, are earthy-toned gnomes that live deep below the surface. They prefer to isolate themselves from other underground societies, which are often cruel and conniving by deep gnome standards.

tiefling.name: Tiefling
tiefling.facts: Intelligence +1, Charisma +2. Sees in the dark, taint of chaos, wing flying. Resists fire. About 5 ft 9 in tall, 190 pounds. Lives up to 124 years. Knows undercommon, darkness globe.
tiefling.unlike: Of the races: alone with taint of chaos.
tiefling.help: Tieflings are mortals with a trace of heritage from the lower planes of existence. This demonic, devilish, or otherwise fiendish bloodline leads to certain traits of corruption, often resulting in physical manifestations such as horns, tails, forked tongues, scaley skin, inhuman eyes, etc. Mature Tieflings gain winged flight at level 30.

vampire.name: Vampire
vampire.facts: No stat changes. Sees in the dark, weapon immunity, vampirism. About 5 ft 10 in tall, 150 pounds.
vampire.unlike: Of the races: alone with weapon immunity, alone with vampirism.
vampire.help: Vampires are highly intelligent undead who draw energy from the living.

zombie.name: Zombie
zombie.facts: No stat changes. Sees in the dark, cause stink. About 5 ft 10 in tall, 150 pounds.
zombie.help: Zombies are rotting corpses animated into undeath. They are frequently foot soldiers of necromancers and other undead.
